import asyncio,json,time,statistics
import aiohttp
MODEL="qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M"
URL="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat"
from open_webui.utils.session_pool import get_session,close_session,get_client_timeout
from open_webui.env import AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL

def p(ref):
  return {"model":MODEL,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":f"Reply OK. Ref {ref}."}],"stream":False,"options":{"num_ctx":4096,"num_predict":1,"temperature":0}}

def pack(route,ref,t0,b,status):
  x={"route":route,"ref":ref,"status":status,"wall_ms":round((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,3)}
  for k in ("total_duration","load_duration","prompt_eval_duration","eval_duration","prompt_eval_count","eval_count"):
    if k in b:x[k+"_ms" if k.endswith("_duration") else k]=round(b[k]/1e6,3) if k.endswith("_duration") else b[k]
  return x

async def direct(s,ref):
  data=json.dumps(p(ref),separators=(",",":"));t=time.perf_counter()
  async with s.post(URL,data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=15)) as r:
    b=await r.json();return pack("direct",ref,t,b,r.status)

async def owui(ref):
  s=await get_session();data=json.dumps(p(ref),separators=(",",":"));t=time.perf_counter()
  async with s.request("POST",URL,data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},ssl=AIOHTTP_CLIENT_SESSION_SSL,timeout=get_client_timeout(False)) as r:
    b=await r.json();return pack("owui_session_pool",ref,t,b,r.status)

async def main():
  print("PHASE=matched_warm_pairs")
  async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:
    records=[];paired=[]
    orders=[["direct","owui"],["owui","direct"],["direct","owui"],["owui","direct"]]
    for i,order in enumerate(orders,1):
      ref=str(4000+i);per={}
      for route in order:
        x=await (direct(s,ref) if route=="direct" else owui(ref))
        records.append(x);per[route]=x;print("SAMPLE="+json.dumps(x,separators=(",",":")))
        if x["status"]!=200:raise SystemExit(20)
      paired.append(round(per["owui"]["wall_ms"]-per["direct"]["wall_ms"],3))
    out={}
    for key in ("direct","owui_session_pool"):
      vals=[r["wall_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key]
      srv=[r["total_duration_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key]
      extra=[r["wall_ms"]-r["total_duration_ms"] for r in records if r["route"]==key]
      out[key]={
        "n":len(vals),"median_wall_ms":round(statistics.median(vals),3),"mean_wall_ms":round(statistics.fmean(vals),3),
        "min_wall_ms":round(min(vals),3),"max_wall_ms":round(max(vals),3),
        "median_ollama_total_ms":round(statistics.median(srv),3),
        "median_client_delta_ms":round(statistics.median(extra),3)
      }
    out["paired_owui_minus_direct_ms"]={"samples":paired,"median":round(statistics.median(paired),3),"mean":round(statistics.fmean(paired),3)}
    print("SUMMARY="+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":")))
  await close_session()
asyncio.run(main())
PY
